# Teleoperating Leader Arm for Dual Arm

Authors: Seunghwan Um, Chemin Ahn, Jeong Hwan Park, Sung Jun Lee.
Advisor: Hyouk Ryeol Choi (최혁렬).

Research project on bilateral leader–follower teleoperation with backdrivable leader arms, gravity compensation, and force feedback for a dual-arm robot.

The page includes dual-arm force-feedback and robotic-hand videos, a simulation demonstration, and equations for motion mapping, wrench frame transformation, Jacobian-transpose reflection, Cartesian virtual impedance, torque-to-current conversion, and optional friction feedforward.

The main bilateral robotic-hand demonstration uses increased force-feedback gain to make its response more visible.

KRoC 2026 presentation by Seunghwan Um: 리더암 힘피드백이 가능한 양팔 로봇 텔레오퍼레이션 시스템 개발. Session: [TA6] 특별세션5, 물류 센터 작업을 위한 휴머노이드 기술, February 5, 2026. Official program: https://kros.org/Conference/ConferenceView.asp?AC=0&CODE=CC20250902&CpPage=298
